Each ship is going to have a different turning radius, depending on their size, thrusters and speed so there really isn't much I can do about that. Ships also don't turn exactly the same speed in all directions, they tend to bank into their turns. Meaning they can turn a tighter circle in up and down circles than strictly left right circles.
